content: The term vestibule or vestibulum originates from early 17th-century French, derived from the Latin word vestibulum, meaning entrance court. It has various meanings depending on the context, particularly in anatomy, architecture, and other fields. Anatomy 1. General Definition: In anatomy, a vestibule refers to a small space or cavity located at the beginning of a canal. 2. Vulval Vestibule: This is the anatomical term for the entrance to the vagina. It serves as the boundary between the external genitalia (vulva) and the internal genitalia (vagina). The Bartholin's glands are located in this region. 3. Nasal Vestibule: This refers to the nostrils, which are lined with an extension of skin epithelium. In contrast, the nasal cavity is lined with respiratory epithelium. 4. Vestibule of the Ear: This is the central part of the labyrinth, which plays a role in the vestibular system responsible for balance and spatial orientation. 5. Vestibule of the Larynx: This is the region between the epiglottis and the rima glottidis. 6. Aortic Vestibule: This is the portion of the left ventricle of the heart located just below the aortic valve. 7. Vestibule of the Mouth: This term refers to the space within the oral cavity. Architecture 1. A vestibule in architecture refers to a large entrance area, such as a lobby, entrance hall, or passage between the outer door and the interior of a building. 2. It can also describe an enclosed area between two rail cars. 3. Other uses include a reception area, an antechamber, an entry room, or a passageway acting as an airlock between two environments. 4. In some contexts, it may refer to a covered section between the outer and inner openings of a tent, often used for storing boots, packs, or small equipment. Music 1. Vestibule (Texas Band): A Christian worship/rock band based in North and South Texas. 2. Vestibule (Oxford Band): A rock/post-rock band from Oxford, UK. 3. Song: Vestibule is also the title of a song by the band They Might Be Giants. Other 1. The Vestibules: Formerly known as Radio Free Vestibule, this is a Canadian comedy troupe.
